title: Write an FPS from scratch with only the docs bundle
skipReason: the template's own unit tests import the template's modules, which a from-scratch game does not have
prompt: Write a complete first-person shooter from nothing. There is no existing game code: you are writing src/game.ts and src/prefabs.ts from scratch. The game must define the world and the player, spawn three enemy capsules that chase the player and damage it on contact, let the player shoot them with a hitscan weapon, show health and ammo on the HUD, and declare a win when all three are dead. Use only what the documentation above describes.

checks.note: the entry point is a defineGame call
imports the SDK, not a package path
